messages:
elaine: starting a staggered canary for release v2.14.0 in the 02:00-04:00 change window. initial traffic 1% to cohort A with feature flag `new-ranking=on`. ramp plan: 1% -> 3% -> 10% over 25m, with safety holdpoints. deploy-bot to post checkpoints. pls monitor traces and errors :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deploy created for v2.14.0 (sha=ab12cd3). Canary cohort A: 1% traffic. smoke tests queued. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.14.0/notes

samir: seeing increased 5xx from routing nodes at ~7m. sampled logs show rate_limiter: quota_exceeded spikes. snippet: ```rate_limiter quota_exceeded count=87 window=60s```

devops-jen: probable token-bucket burst. recommend pausing ramp at 1%, increment node rate limit by +15% for canary, and re-evaluate. If risky to change infra mid-deploy, prefer pinning traffic back to v2.13.5.

matthew: +1 to hold. Also suggest a quick auto-fallback rule: if cohort error_rate >0.5% for 2m -> flip new-ranking to 0% and shift affected cohort to v2.13.5 automatically.

elaine: holding ramp. updating rollout doc: hold at 1% until infra tune. will set a runtime holdpoint and add a human confirmation before further ramps. pin rollback target to v2.13.5.

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 1%. Actions: set `canary_hold=true`, created runbook https://internal.ops/runbooks/v2.14.0-rollout, notified oncall.

oncall-bot: ALERT: canary error budget breached (threshold=0.5%). current error_rate=0.92%. paging: samir, devops-jen

samir: plan: 1) apply safe rate-limit bump (+15%) to canary nodes via infra API 2) monitor 5m avg 3) if error_rate >0.5% after 5m -> flip flag to 0% -> route cohorts to v2.13.5 -> run smoke tests and quick evals

devops-jen: applied rate-limit bump: `infractl update rate-limit --filter canary --mult 1.15`. watching metrics for 3m. curl toggle endpoint for rollback: ```curl -X POST https://infra.redwood/api/flags/new-ranking -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"percentage":0}'```

matthew: if flip happens, capture a 50-sample eval set against the canary prompt list so we can compare quality before/after rollback. add to the postmortem if triggered.

samir: kickstarting quick evals now; expecting first signals in ~8-10m. will post scores.

elaine: updating release notes: "Canary temporarily paused for rate-limiter investigation; holding at 1%." Will coordinate a follow-up once infra metrics stabilize. keep pings in thread. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Update: after rate-limit bump, 5m avg error_rate decreased to 0.31%. Canary ramp authorized to 3% per updated plan. Continuing monitoring and will checkpoint at next 10m interval.
